import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_index = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    oi = db['order_items']
    oi_valid = oi[(oi['ts'] < seed_time) & (oi['product_id'].isin(entity_ids))].copy()

    feature_cols = [
        'total_units_sold', 'total_orders_with_product', 'total_sellers',
        'total_revenue', 'total_freight', 'avg_price', 'avg_freight_per_unit',
        'time_since_last_sale_days', 'max_price', 'min_price', 'price_std',
        'sales_last_30d', 'sales_last_90d', 'sales_prev_90d', 'trend_90d',
        'count_delivered_orders', 'count_canceled_orders', 'count_unavailable_orders',
        'avg_delivery_time_days', 'count_late_deliveries',
        'total_reviews', 'has_reviews', 'avg_review_score',
        'count_5star', 'count_1star', 'share_5star', 'share_1star',
        'days_since_last_review', 'total_payment_value_orders',
        'avg_payment_value_per_order', 'count_credit_card_payments',
        'count_boleto_payments', 'count_installment_payments', 'avg_installments'
    ]

    if oi_valid.empty:
        out = entity_index.copy()
        out[feature_cols] = 0.0
        out['time_since_last_sale_days'] = 1000.0
        out['days_since_last_review'] = 1000.0
        return out.reindex(entity_ids)

    relevant_order_ids = oi_valid['order_id'].unique()

    orders = db['orders']
    orders_valid = orders[
        (orders['order_id'].isin(relevant_order_ids)) &
        (orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    payments = db['payments']
    payments_valid = payments[
        (payments['order_id'].isin(relevant_order_ids)) &
        (payments['ts'] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    reviews = db['reviews']
    reviews_valid = reviews[
        (reviews['order_id'].isin(relevant_order_ids)) &
        (reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # --------------------------
    # Order items features
    # --------------------------
    oi_agg = oi_valid.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_units_sold=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        total_orders_with_product=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight_per_unit=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        last_sale_time=('ts', 'max'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        price_std=('price', 'std')
    )
    oi_agg['time_since_last_sale_days'] = (seed_time - oi_agg['last_sale_time']).dt.days.astype(float)
    oi_agg.drop(columns=['last_sale_time'], inplace=True)

    ts30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    ts90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    ts180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    recent = oi_valid[oi_valid['ts'] >= ts30].groupby('product_id')['order_item_id'].count()
    r90 = oi_valid[oi_valid['ts'] >= ts90].groupby('product_id')['order_item_id'].count()
    prev90 = oi_valid[(oi_valid['ts'] >= ts180) & (oi_valid['ts'] < ts90)].groupby('product_id')['order_item_id'].count()

    oi_agg['sales_last_30d'] = recent.reindex(oi_agg.index).fillna(0)
    oi_agg['sales_last_90d'] = r90.reindex(oi_agg.index).fillna(0)
    oi_agg['sales_prev_90d'] = prev90.reindex(oi_agg.index).fillna(0)
    oi_agg['trend_90d'] = oi_agg['sales_last_90d'] - oi_agg['sales_prev_90d']

    # --------------------------
    # Order status / delivery features
    # Только заказы, у которых событие (покупка / доставка) уже произошло до seed_time
    # --------------------------
    oi_orders = oi_valid[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(
        orders_valid, on='order_id', how='left'
    )

    delivered_mask = (
        (oi_orders['order_status'] == 'delivered') &
        (oi_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) &
        (oi_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    )
    delivered = oi_orders[delivered_mask]

    status_counts = oi_orders.groupby('product_id')['order_status'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
    for col, name in [('delivered', 'count_delivered_orders'),
                      ('canceled', 'count_canceled_orders'),
                      ('unavailable', 'count_unavailable_orders')]:
        if col in status_counts.columns:
            oi_agg[name] = status_counts[col].reindex(oi_agg.index).fillna(0)
        else:
            oi_agg[name] = 0.0

    if not delivered.empty:
        delivery_times = (
            delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] - delivered['order_purchase_timestamp']
        ).dt.days
        tmp = pd.DataFrame({'product_id': delivered['product_id'].values,
                            'dt': delivery_times.values,
                            'late': (delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] >
                                     delivered['order_estimated_delivery_date']).astype(float).values})
        agg = tmp.groupby('product_id').agg(avg_delivery_time_days=('dt', 'mean'),
                                            count_late_deliveries=('late', 'sum'))
        oi_agg['avg_delivery_time_days'] = agg['avg_delivery_time_days'].reindex(oi_agg.index)
        oi_agg['count_late_deliveries'] = agg['count_late_deliveries'].reindex(oi_agg.index).fillna(0)
    else:
        oi_agg['avg_delivery_time_days'] = np.nan
        oi_agg['count_late_deliveries'] = 0.0

    # --------------------------
    # Review features (только отзывы, созданные до seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    if not reviews_valid.empty:
        oi_reviews = oi_valid[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(
            reviews_valid[['order_id', 'review_score', 'review_creation_date']],
            on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        rev_agg = oi_reviews.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            count_5star=('review_score', lambda s: (s == 5).sum()),
            count_1star=('review_score', lambda s: (s == 1).sum()),
            last_review_time=('review_creation_date', 'max')
        )
        rev_agg['share_5star'] = rev_agg['count_5star'] / rev_agg['total_reviews'].replace(0, np.nan)
        rev_agg['share_1star'] = rev_agg['count_1star'] / rev_agg['total_reviews'].replace(0, np.nan)
        rev_agg['has_reviews'] = (rev_agg['total_reviews'] > 0).astype(float)
        rev_agg['days_since_last_review'] = (seed_time - rev_agg['last_review_time']).dt.days.astype(float)
        rev_agg.drop(columns=['last_review_time'], inplace=True)
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['total_reviews', 'avg_review_score', 'count_5star',
                                        'count_1star', 'share_5star', 'share_1star',
                                        'has_reviews', 'days_since_last_review'])

    # --------------------------
    # Payment features (только платежи, произошедшие до seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    if not payments_valid.empty:
        payments_per_order = payments_valid.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_order_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            avg_installments_order=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            count_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').sum()),
            count_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'boleto').sum()),
            count_installment_pay=('payment_installments', lambda x: (x > 1).sum())
        ).reset_index()

        oi_payments = oi_valid[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(
            payments_per_order, on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        pay_agg = oi_payments.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_payment_value_orders=('total_order_payment', 'sum'),
            avg_payment_value_per_order=('total_order_payment', 'mean'),
            count_credit_card_payments=('count_credit_card', 'sum'),
            count_boleto_payments=('count_boleto', 'sum'),
            count_installment_payments=('count_installment_pay', 'sum'),
            avg_installments=('avg_installments_order', 'mean')
        )
    else:
        pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['total_payment_value_orders', 'avg_payment_value_per_order',
                                        'count_credit_card_payments', 'count_boleto_payments',
                                        'count_installment_payments', 'avg_installments'])

    # --------------------------
    # Merge
    # --------------------------
    final_features = entity_index.join(oi_agg, how='left')
    final_features = final_features.join(rev_agg, how='left')
    final_features = final_features.join(pay_agg, how='left')

    fill_map = {col: 0.0 for col in final_features.columns}
    fill_map['time_since_last_sale_days'] = 1000.0
    fill_map['days_since_last_review'] = 1000.0
    final_features = final_features.fillna(fill_map)

    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features.index.name = 'product_id'
    return final_features
